name: pi-reviewer

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun build ./src/cli.ts ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.clean: bun -e 'import { rm } from "node:fs/promises"; await rm("dist", { recursive: true, force: true })'

description: Precision-first, read-only AI code reviews powered by Pi
